//: VFM Frontend Code Standards — React/Next specific. MERGE ORDER: templates/shared/eslintrc.conventions.json FIRST (naming, imports, max-lines 300, max-lines-per-function 30, clean-code metrics), THEN this file on top. `npm run lint` MUST pass before a frontend task is marked complete. See helpers/code-quality.md → 'Frontend Code Standards'.
//requires: npm i -D eslint-plugin-react (plus the shared file's requirements)
//verify: npx eslint --print-config <any>.tsx | grep -E 'no-multi-comp|max-lines' — both MUST appear. A gate you did not grep for is a gate you do not have.
//covers: Standard #1 (one component per file) and #4 (no static inline style). Standards #2 (design tokens) and #3 (extract shared logic) have NO lint rule — google-code-reviewer is their only gate.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Rule #4: no STATIC inline styles. Use a Tailwind utility class. style={} is allowed ONLY when the value is computed from a variable at runtime.

overrides.//: Components legitimately exceed the generic 30-line function limit (JSX is markup, not logic). Keep the FILE limit at 300 — that one is not relaxed.
Tests are allowed to be long and repetitive — clarity beats brevity in a spec.
